stem: The professor ____ encouraged me to apply for the scholarship is now the dean of our college.
explain_zh: 先行詞 The professor 是人，且在關係子句中當主詞（encouraged 的主詞），要用主格關係代名詞 who。whom 是受格、whose 是所有格、which 只能指物。口訣：人當主詞用 who。

stem: The mentor to ____ I owe most of my confidence still writes to me every winter holiday.
explain_zh: 介系詞 to 後面的關係代名詞一定要用受格 whom，不能用 who，也不能用 that。whose 是所有格，後面必須接名詞。記住：介系詞＋whom 是正式寫法。

stem: The engineer ____ design won the national competition now studies at our partner university.
explain_zh: 空格後面接名詞 design，表示「那位工程師的設計」，要用所有格關係代名詞 whose。who 是主格、whom 是受格，後面都不能直接接名詞；which 不能指人。

stem: Our school installed solar panels on the roof, ____ cut the electricity bill by nearly half.
explain_zh: 逗號後面是非限定用法，只能用 which，不能用 that。what 本身不需要先行詞，who 只能指人。記住：逗號之後絕不接 that。

stem: This is the only translation app ____ can turn a whole lecture into subtitles in real time.
explain_zh: 先行詞被 the only 修飾時，關係代名詞習慣用 that。what 前面不能有先行詞，whose 後面要接名詞，whom 是受格不能當主詞。

stem: Everything ____ the committee announced yesterday morning has already been posted on the school website.
explain_zh: 先行詞是 everything 這類不定代名詞時，關係代名詞用 that 而不用 which。what 不能有先行詞，who 只指人。口訣：everything／anything／all 後面配 that。

stem: ____ surprised us most was the number of students who signed up for the recycling club.
explain_zh: 句首沒有先行詞，需要一個「本身就含先行詞」的關係代名詞 what（＝the thing that）。That 引導名詞子句時後面要接完整句子，這裡 surprised 缺主詞，故不可用。

stem: The documentary we watched in class last Friday ____ about plastic waste in the Pacific Ocean.
explain_zh: we watched in class 是省略受格關係代名詞的關係子句，修飾 The documentary，所以主要子句還缺一個動詞，填 was。選 which was／that was 會讓整句沒有主要動詞，being 也不能單獨當動詞。

stem: The laboratory ____ we conducted the water experiment has just been renovated by the school.
explain_zh: conduct the experiment in the laboratory，關係子句裡少的是「地點介系詞 in」，所以用 in which。單獨的 which 會讓 in 不見，of which 語意不通，whose 後面要接名詞。

stem: My roommate, ____ I have shared a small flat for three years, is moving to Kaohsiung next month.
explain_zh: share a flat with somebody，介系詞 with 移到關係代名詞前面時必須接受格 whom，不能用 with who。少了 with 的 who／whom 會使 share 的對象不見。

stem: The second-hand bicycle ____ I bought online last month arrived with a broken front brake.
explain_zh: 先行詞 bicycle 是物，關係代名詞在子句中當 bought 的受詞，用 that（也可用 which）。what 不能有先行詞，who 只指人，whose 後面必須接名詞。

stem: The volunteers, ____ came from six different countries, cleaned the riverbank together last weekend.
explain_zh: 逗號後的非限定子句不能用 that；先行詞是人且在子句中當主詞，所以用 who。whom 是受格，which 只能指物。

stem: Last week we visited a small factory ____ machines are powered entirely by wind and sunlight.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 machines，表示「那間工廠的機器」，所有格關係代名詞 whose 也可以用來指物。which 和 that 後面不能直接接名詞，what 不能有先行詞。

stem: The candidate ____ the selection committee finally chose had the least working experience of all.
explain_zh: 先行詞 candidate 是人，在關係子句中當 chose 的受詞，正式用法用受格 whom。which 指物，what 不能有先行詞，whose 後面要接名詞。

stem: The mountain village ____ population has fallen below two hundred may soon lose its only school.
explain_zh: 空格後是名詞 population，需要所有格 whose，意思是「這個村子的人口」。which 和 that 後面必須接動詞或主詞，who 只能指人。

stem: Students ____ submit the online survey before Friday noon will receive a free reusable notebook.
explain_zh: 先行詞 Students 是人，且是 submit 的主詞，用主格 who。whom 只能當受詞，whose 後面要接名詞，which 不能指人。

stem: She finally found a part-time job ____ pays well and still leaves her enough time to study.
explain_zh: 先行詞 job 是物，關係代名詞在子句中當 pays 的主詞，用 that（或 which）。what 不能有先行詞，who 指人，whose 後面要接名詞。

stem: The smartphone ____ screen cracked during the field trip still works perfectly well today.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 screen，表示「那支手機的螢幕」，用所有格 whose。which／that 後面不能直接接名詞，who 只能指人。

stem: The international conference ____ our teacher spoke was streamed live to thousands of viewers.
explain_zh: speak at a conference，關係子句缺的是地點介系詞 at，所以用 at which。單獨的 which 或 that 會讓 spoke 後面少了介系詞，in that 是「因為」的連接詞，語意不合。

stem: The examination results ____ we had been waiting for were finally released this morning.
explain_zh: 先行詞 results 是物，關係代名詞當句尾 for 的受詞，用 that（或 which）。what 不能有先行詞，whose 後面要接名詞，whom 只能指人。

stem: I still clearly remember ____ he said about protecting the coral reefs near Kenting.
explain_zh: remember 後面缺受詞，而 said 後面也缺受詞，需要一個同時含先行詞的 what（＝the thing that）。that 引導的子句必須完整，which 和 whose 都需要先行詞。

stem: The old town library, ____ was built in 1935, will be turned into a quiet study centre.
explain_zh: 逗號引導的非限定子句補充說明 library，指物且不能用 that，所以用 which。what 不需要先行詞，who 只能指人。

stem: The exchange student we invited to the opening ceremony ____ a short speech in Chinese.
explain_zh: we invited to the opening ceremony 是省略了受格關係代名詞的子句，修飾主詞 The exchange student，因此整句還缺主要動詞，用過去式 gave。其餘三個都不是可以單獨當述語的形式。

stem: The navigation app ____ my older brother designed helps blind users cross busy streets safely.
explain_zh: 先行詞 app 是物，關係代名詞當 designed 的受詞，用 that（或 which）。what 不能有先行詞，who 指人，whose 後面要接名詞。

stem: The scientists ____ we are deeply grateful will visit our campus again next spring.
explain_zh: be grateful to somebody，介系詞 to 提前時後面必須接受格 whom，不能寫成 to who。若只用 whom 或 that，grateful 後面就少了介系詞 to。

stem: There are very few things ____ worry senior high school students more than examination results.
explain_zh: 先行詞前面有 few 這類限定詞時，關係代名詞習慣用 that，而且它在子句中當 worry 的主詞。what 不能有先行詞，whose 要接名詞，whom 不能當主詞。

stem: He forgot to save the shared file before closing it, ____ made the whole team stay late.
explain_zh: 逗號後的 which 可以代表「前面整件事」，指他忘了存檔這件事。that 不能用於非限定子句，what 不能有先行詞，who 只能指人。

stem: The activity centre ____ roof was badly damaged by the typhoon has been closed for repairs.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 roof，表示「活動中心的屋頂」，要用所有格 whose。which 和 that 後面不能直接接名詞，what 不能有先行詞。

stem: All ____ the volunteers need is a pair of thick gloves and a large rubbish bag.
explain_zh: 先行詞是 All 時，關係代名詞只能用 that，不能用 which。what 本身已含先行詞，不能再放在 All 後面；who 只能指人。

stem: The young journalist ____ interviewed the mayor also wrote a long report on the new bus route.
explain_zh: 先行詞 journalist 是人，在子句中當 interviewed 的主詞，用主格 who。whom 只能當受詞，which 指物，what 不能有先行詞。

stem: I will never forget the day ____ our team finally won the national science fair.
explain_zh: 先行詞 the day 是時間，後面接完整的句子，要用關係副詞 when（＝on which）。which 是關係代名詞，後面的句子必須缺主詞或受詞；where 指地點，whose 後面要接名詞。

stem: This is the small café ____ our group usually discusses the details of our class projects.
explain_zh: 先行詞 café 是地點，而後面 discusses the details 是完整句子，所以用關係副詞 where（＝in which）。which 後面的句子必須缺成分，when 指時間，whose 要接名詞。

stem: Nobody in the office could explain the reason ____ the server crashed during the online exam.
explain_zh: 先行詞是 the reason，要用關係副詞 why 引導理由。how 不能和 the way 以外的先行詞連用，where 指地點，which 後面的句子不能是完整句。

stem: The natural history museum ____ those dinosaur fossils are displayed opens at nine on weekdays.
explain_zh: 先行詞 museum 是地點，後面 fossils are displayed 是完整子句，所以用 where。which 後面必須缺主詞或受詞，whose 要接名詞，when 指時間。

stem: Summer is the season ____ electricity demand in Taiwan usually reaches its yearly peak.
explain_zh: 先行詞 the season 表時間，後面是完整句子，用關係副詞 when。where 指地點，which 後面不能接完整句，why 只能接在 reason 之後。

stem: That is exactly ____ scientists measure the age of ancient ice taken from deep glaciers.
explain_zh: 整句在說明「方法」，用 how（＝the way in which）。why 表原因、when 表時間、where 表地點，都與「如何測量」的語意不符。

stem: The seaside town ____ we visited last year now has a convenient bike-sharing system.
explain_zh: 雖然先行詞是地點，但 visited 後面缺受詞，所以要用關係代名詞 which，不能用 where。關係副詞 where 後面必須是完整句子。

stem: The city stadium ____ was rebuilt after the earthquake can now hold twenty thousand people.
explain_zh: 空格後的 was rebuilt 缺主詞，所以要用關係代名詞 which，不能用關係副詞 where。判斷重點：後面句子完整用 where，缺成分用 which。

stem: There are quiet moments ____ a long silence says far more than any prepared speech.
explain_zh: 先行詞 moments 表時間，後面是完整子句，用關係副詞 when。which 後面必須缺成分，where 指地點，what 不能有先行詞。

stem: Please tell me the real reason ____ you deleted the shared document without asking anyone.
explain_zh: 先行詞是 the reason，用關係副詞 why 引導原因子句。which 後面不能接完整句，where 指地點，how 不與 reason 連用。

stem: The research laboratory ____ she works every afternoon has extremely strict safety rules.
explain_zh: 先行詞 laboratory 是地點，且 she works 是完整句子，用 where。which 或 that 後面的句子必須缺主詞或受詞，when 指時間。

stem: Do you still remember the summer ____ we planted young trees along the riverbank together?
explain_zh: 先行詞 the summer 表時間，後面接完整句子，用關係副詞 when。where 指地點，which 後面必須缺成分，whose 要接名詞。

stem: Could you please tell me ____ the registration form for the summer camp?
explain_zh: 名詞子句當 tell 的受詞時要用直述句語序「疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞」，所以是 where I can find。其餘三個仍保留疑問句倒裝或語序錯誤。

stem: ____ the team won the national championship made the whole school celebrate for days.
explain_zh: 空格後 the team won the championship 是完整句子，當主詞用的名詞子句要用 That 引導。What 後面必須缺成分，Which 不能引導主詞子句，If 引導的子句不能當句首主詞。

stem: The real problem is ____ nobody in the group wants to take responsibility for the mistake.
explain_zh: be 動詞後面接名詞子句當主詞補語，子句本身完整，用 that。what 後面要缺成分，which 不能這樣用，whether 表「是否」語意不合。

stem: I am really not sure ____ that expensive online course is worth the money.
explain_zh: not sure 後面表達「是否」的不確定，要用 whether（或 if）。that 表肯定的事實，what 後面要缺成分，which 需要有選擇範圍。

stem: The physics teacher asked me ____ I had already finished the laboratory report.
explain_zh: 間接問句若原本是 Yes/No 問句，要用 if 或 whether 引導。that 用於直述內容，what 和 which 後面都必須缺成分。

stem: ____ or not we go hiking this Saturday depends entirely on the weather forecast.
explain_zh: 只有 whether 可以直接和 or not 連用，也只有 whether 引導的子句能放句首當主詞。If 不能當主詞子句，That 不能接 or not，What 後面要缺成分。

stem: What really surprises me is ____ so few students use the school's free counselling service.
explain_zh: be 動詞後面的名詞子句內容完整，用 that 引導。what 後面必須缺成分，which 用於有限選項，how many 後面要接名詞。

stem: Researchers have already proved ____ tiny microplastics can enter the human bloodstream.
explain_zh: proved 後面接的是一件被證實的事實，子句完整，用 that。what 和 which 後面都要缺成分，if 表「是否」與 prove 的語意不搭。

stem: Do you happen to know ____ the last bus to the train station usually arrives?
explain_zh: 間接問句要用直述句語序，所以只要 when＋主詞＋動詞。when does 是疑問倒裝，when is 動詞錯誤，that when 兩個引導詞不能連用。

stem: I really wonder ____ the school suddenly decided to cancel this year's sports day.
explain_zh: wonder 後面的間接問句不可倒裝，用 why＋主詞＋動詞。why did 是疑問語序，that why 重複引導詞，why has 與後面的過去式動詞不合。

stem: It is widely believed ____ reading a paper book before bed improves sleep quality.
explain_zh: It is believed that... 是常見句型，虛主詞 It 代替後面的 that 子句。what 和 which 後面要缺成分，whether 表不確定，與 widely believed 語意不合。

stem: ____ the government will fund the wetland restoration project still remains unclear.
explain_zh: 句首的主詞子句表示「是否」，只能用 Whether，If 不能引導主詞子句。That 會變成肯定事實，與 remains unclear 矛盾；What 後面必須缺成分。

stem: My only question is ____ we should submit the final report online or on paper.
explain_zh: 句意是「要線上還是紙本」，是二選一的不確定，用 whether...or。that 表肯定事實，what 後面要缺成分，which 後面需接名詞或有明確選項。

stem: Please tell me honestly ____ you did with the leftover materials from the workshop.
explain_zh: did 後面缺受詞，需要用 what 引導名詞子句並同時當受詞。that 引導的子句必須完整，which 需有選擇範圍，whether 表是否，語意不合。

stem: No one in the building could explain ____ caused the sudden power cut last night.
explain_zh: caused 前面缺主詞，要用 what 當名詞子句的主詞（＝the thing that）。that 後面要接完整句子，which 需有限定範圍，whether 語意不合。

stem: ____ the volunteers had quietly done for the neighbourhood impressed the whole community.
explain_zh: done 後面缺受詞，所以要用本身含先行詞的 What 當主詞子句的引導詞。That 後面的子句必須完整，Which 不能這樣引導主詞子句，Whether 語意不合。

stem: I honestly have no idea ____ the password to the shared class folder is.
explain_zh: 間接問句不可倒裝，所以是 what＋主詞＋is。what is 是疑問語序，that 後面必須是完整句子，which 需要有明確選項。

stem: ____ the app quietly collects our location data concerns many parents and teachers.
explain_zh: 空格後是完整句子，當主詞的名詞子句用 That 引導。What 後面必須缺成分，Which 和 Whom 都不能引導這樣的主詞子句。

stem: She still could not decide ____ to major in engineering or in visual design.
explain_zh: 只有 whether 可以直接接不定詞，構成 whether to V...or...。if 不能接不定詞，that 不引導選擇，what 後面要缺成分。

stem: The fact ____ our campus wastes so much paper really shocked the visiting students.
explain_zh: The fact 後面接同位語子句說明「事實的內容」，子句完整，用 that。which 和 why 是關係詞，what 不能有先行詞。

stem: Please let me know ____ you need any extra help with tomorrow's group presentation.
explain_zh: let me know 後面表示「是否需要幫忙」，用 if（或 whether）。that 表肯定事實，what 和 which 後面都必須缺成分。

stem: ____ the earth is warming faster than expected is no longer a matter of debate.
explain_zh: 空格後是完整句子且內容是被接受的事實，用 That 引導主詞子句。What 後面要缺成分，Whether 表懷疑與 no longer a matter of debate 矛盾，Which 不能這樣用。

stem: The coach really wanted to know ____ we had practised during the winter holiday.
explain_zh: 間接問句用直述語序，how often＋主詞＋動詞即可。how often did 是倒裝，that how often 重複引導詞，how often do 與過去完成式不合。

stem: It does not really matter ____ you start the project, as long as you finish on time.
explain_zh: 句意強調「什麼時候開始都沒關係」，用 when 引導名詞子句。that 表肯定事實，what 和 which 後面必須缺成分，這裡 start 已有受詞 the project。

stem: The new bike lanes along the riverside ____ by the city government last summer.
explain_zh: 時間是 last summer，主詞 bike lanes 是被建造的，所以用過去式被動 were built。are built 時態錯誤，have built 和 were building 都是主動語態。

stem: The final results ____ on the school website since early Monday morning.
explain_zh: since 搭配現在完成式，而 results 是被公布的，所以用現在完成被動 have been posted。其餘三個都是主動語態，語意不通。

stem: All the glass equipment must ____ carefully before the students leave the chemistry laboratory.
explain_zh: 情態助動詞 must 後面接原形，被動語態是 must be checked。been checked 前面必須有 have，check 是主動，checking 不能接在 must 後面。

stem: A brand-new recycling system ____ in every classroom at the start of next semester.
explain_zh: next semester 指未來，而 system 是被安裝的，用未來式被動 will be installed。will install 和 will have installed 都是主動，is installing 也是主動進行式。

stem: The pedestrian bridge ____ at the moment, so please take the other route to school.
explain_zh: at the moment 表示現在正在進行，而橋是被修理的，用現在進行被動 is being repaired。其他三個都是主動語態。

stem: The two winners ____ a free trip to Japan by the camp organisers last Friday.
explain_zh: give 有兩個受詞，把「人」提到主詞位置時是 were given a free trip，不需要再加 to。gave 和 giving 都是主動，語意不通。

stem: A full four-year scholarship ____ to her shortly after the final interview.
explain_zh: 雙受詞動詞 offer 以「物」當主詞時，後面要加介系詞 to 再接人，動詞用被動 was offered。其餘三個都是主動語態。

stem: The suspect ____ to enter the building through the back door just after midnight.
explain_zh: 感官動詞 see 在主動時接原形 V，變被動時原形要還原成 to V，所以是 was seen to enter。其他三個都是主動語態。

stem: The careless students ____ to rewrite the whole report over the weekend.
explain_zh: 使役動詞 make 主動時接原形，改被動要加 to，所以是 were made to rewrite。were make 文法錯誤，made 和 were making 都是主動。

stem: Junior students ____ to wear the full school uniform on every Monday morning.
explain_zh: 學生是「被要求」的一方，用被動 are required to V。require 和 are requiring 是主動，required 單獨用在這裡也會變成主動。

stem: The confirmation email must ____ to the wrong address, because nobody received it.
explain_zh: 對過去的推測用 must have p.p.，而 email 是被寄出的，所以是 must have been sent。be sent 指現在或未來，have sent 是主動，send 沒有被動也沒有過去意味。

stem: By the time we arrived at the hall, the stage ____ with hundreds of paper flowers.
explain_zh: 在過去某時間點之前已完成，且舞台是被裝飾的，用過去完成被動 had been decorated。had decorated 是主動，was decorating 也是主動，has been decorated 時態與 arrived 不合。

stem: This coffee machine in the teachers' lounge needs ____ at least once a year.
explain_zh: 機器是被保養的，need 後面接不定詞時要用被動 to be serviced。to service 變成機器去保養別人，service 和 serviced 都不能直接接在 needs 後面。

stem: My new phone ____ stolen on the crowded train during the school trip last week.
explain_zh: 口語中常用 get＋p.p. 表示被動，尤其是不幸的事，所以是 got stolen。was got 不合英語習慣，has got 和 is getting 時態與 last week 不合。

stem: The huge mural on the back wall ____ by students from the art club last year.
explain_zh: 壁畫是被畫的，加上 last year 指過去，用過去式被動 was painted。painted 單獨用會變成壁畫去畫別人，其餘兩個也是主動語態。

stem: Used plastic bottles ____ into soft fabric if the right technology is available.
explain_zh: 情態助動詞的被動是 can be p.p.，寶特瓶是被轉變的，所以用 can be turned。can turn 是主動，can be turning 是進行式，can turned 文法錯誤。

stem: English ____ as an official language in more than fifty countries around the world.
explain_zh: 英語是被使用的語言，敘述現在的事實用現在式被動 is spoken。其餘三個都是主動語態，會變成「英語會說話」。

stem: By next June, all the old classrooms ____ with energy-saving air conditioners.
explain_zh: By next June 表示「到未來某時間點為止已完成」，用未來完成被動 will have been installed。will be installed 缺少「已完成」的意思，have been installed 不能指未來，will install 是主動。

stem: We ____ a very detailed explanation about the fossils by the friendly museum guide.
explain_zh: tell 可以接人當受詞，變被動時是 we were told...；say 不能用人當被動主詞，所以 were said 錯誤。told 和 said 在這裡都是主動語態。

stem: The children ____ playing loudly in the schoolyard when the fire alarm suddenly rang.
explain_zh: 感官動詞 hear 的被動是 be heard，後面可以接 V-ing 表示當時正在進行的動作。heard 和 hear 是主動，were hearing 不符合感官動詞的用法。

stem: Food waste ____ separated from other rubbish before it goes into the collection truck.
explain_zh: 情態助動詞的被動形式是 should be p.p.，廚餘是被分開的。should 後面直接接 separated 會少了 be，should being 和 should been 都是錯誤形式。

stem: The final test results ____ when the power in the whole building suddenly went out.
explain_zh: 停電時「正在被列印」，用過去進行被動 were being printed。were printing 和 had printed 是主動，are being printed 時態與 went out 不合。

stem: The new traffic policy ____ to reduce serious accidents by nearly half within two years.
explain_zh: 「據說…」的句型是 be said to V，所以用 is said to reduce。says 和 is saying 是主動，said 單獨用會缺少 be 動詞。

stem: Visitors ____ to take photographs with flash inside the main exhibition hall.
explain_zh: 參觀者是被規定的一方，用被動 are not allowed to V。do not allow 和 are not allowing 都變成參觀者不允許別人，not allowed 缺少 be 動詞。

stem: Tina told us that she ____ to the recycling centre the previous weekend with her family.
explain_zh: 主要動詞 told 是過去式，原本的過去式要往前退成過去完成式 had gone，而且 the previous weekend 也是轉述後的時間說法。其餘三個都沒有做時態往前退的調整。

stem: The guide said that the museum ____ at six o'clock every evening during the winter season.
explain_zh: 轉述動詞 said 是過去式，原句的現在式習慣要退成過去式 closed。has closed 與 said 不搭，is closing 沒有退時態，closes 保留現在式在正式寫作中不合規則。

stem: He asked me ____ I had ever taken part in a model United Nations conference before.
explain_zh: 原句是 Yes/No 問句，轉述時要用 if 或 whether 引導。that 用於直述句，what 後面必須缺成分，did 不能引導間接問句。

stem: My homeroom teacher asked us ____ our service projects before the end of this month.
explain_zh: ask somebody to V 是轉述請求或要求的固定句型。finish 原形、finishing 動名詞、that finish 都不符合 ask 的句型。

stem: The reporter asked the mayor ____ the new low-carbon bus policy would officially begin.
explain_zh: 間接問句要用直述語序 when＋主詞＋動詞。when would 是倒裝，that when 重複引導詞，when will 沒有配合過去的轉述動詞退時態。

stem: Our basketball coach ____ us that the training session had been moved to Saturday morning.
explain_zh: tell 後面可以直接接人再接 that 子句，所以用 told us that...。say 要寫成 said to us，speak 和 talk 則要加 to 才能接人。

stem: Our team leader ____ that the second week of the camp would be much harder.
explain_zh: say 後面可以直接接 that 子句，不接人；tell 一定要先接人，所以 told 和 told to 都錯。speak 不能直接接 that 子句。

stem: On Monday she said that she would hand in her application ____, which meant Tuesday.
explain_zh: 轉述過去說的話時，tomorrow 要改成 the next day。yesterday 和 that day 指的時間都不對，tomorrow 是從現在算的，與 said 的過去觀點不合。

stem: David told me that he had once again forgotten ____ password for the school computer.
explain_zh: 轉述時人稱代名詞要跟著轉換，David 說的 my 在轉述句中要改成 his。my 會變成說話者自己的，your 和 their 指的人都不對。

stem: The librarian told the students ____ their phones while they were in the reading room.
explain_zh: 轉述否定命令的標準形式是 tell somebody not to V。to not use 語序不自然，don't use 保留了直接引語，not use 少了 to。

stem: The science teacher explained that water ____ at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
explain_zh: 轉述的內容若是科學真理或不變的事實，時態不必往前退，維持現在式 boils。其餘三個都把不變的事實改成了過去，不符合慣例。

stem: She said that she ____ help us with the poster if we needed another pair of hands.
explain_zh: 轉述動詞 said 是過去式，原句的 will 要退成 would。shall 和 can 沒有做時態調整，will 則完全沒有退。

stem: He said that we ____ submit the signed consent form before joining the field trip.
explain_zh: 轉述過去的話時，表示義務的 must 通常改成 had to。must to 文法錯誤，has to 沒有退時態，having to 不能當述語動詞。

stem: The school nurse asked the boy ____ any pain in his left arm after the fall.
explain_zh: 間接問句用 if＋主詞＋動詞，且時態配合過去。if did he feel 是倒裝，that he felt 不是問句形式，does he feel 既倒裝又沒退時態。

stem: Our team leader suggested ____ the survey online instead of printing hundreds of copies.
explain_zh: suggest 後面接動名詞，不能接不定詞，所以用 doing。to do、do、did 都不符合 suggest 的用法。

stem: Tom said that he ____ studying abroad, but his parents preferred a local university.
explain_zh: said 是過去式，原本的現在進行式要退成過去進行式 was considering。is considering 和 considers 沒有退時態，has considered 與轉述的過去觀點不合。

stem: The volunteer leader asked us ____ the rubbish bags by size before loading the truck.
explain_zh: ask somebody to V 是轉述要求的固定用法，所以用 to sort。sorting、sort、sorted 都不能接在 ask us 之後。

stem: She said that ____ documentary had completely changed the way she thought about climate change.
explain_zh: 轉述時指示詞 this 要改成 that，因為說話的時空已經改變。these 是複數，it 不能直接放在名詞前面當限定詞。

stem: Each of the exchange students ____ required to hand in a short reflection after the trip.
explain_zh: Each of＋複數名詞，真正的主詞是 Each，屬單數，動詞用 is。are 和 were 是複數動詞，being 不能單獨當述語動詞。

stem: The number of students who join the coding club ____ growing steadily every single year.
explain_zh: The number of... 意思是「…的數量」，視為單數，動詞用 is。若是 A number of 才表示「許多」而用複數動詞。

stem: A number of local volunteers ____ already signed up for this Saturday's beach clean-up.
explain_zh: A number of＋複數名詞意思是「許多…」，動詞用複數 have。has、is、was 都是單數動詞，與 volunteers 不一致。

stem: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ satisfied with the newly announced timetable.
explain_zh: neither A nor B 的動詞要與最靠近的主詞 the students 一致，所以用複數 are。is、was、has 都是單數動詞。

stem: Physics ____ one of the most challenging subjects for many senior high school students.
explain_zh: physics 雖然字尾有 s，但屬學科名稱，視為單數，動詞用 is。類似的還有 mathematics、economics、news。

stem: Twenty minutes ____ hardly enough time to finish the whole listening section of the test.
explain_zh: 表示時間、金錢、距離的複數名詞當作「一個整體」時，視為單數，動詞用 is。其餘三個都是複數動詞。

stem: There ____ several good reasons why the committee rejected that proposal last week.
explain_zh: There be 句型的動詞要與後面的真主詞 reasons 一致，複數用 are。is、was、has 都不能搭配複數主詞和 last week 之外的現在敘述。

stem: One of the old machines in the science laboratory ____ broken down twice this month.
explain_zh: 主詞是 One，中間的 of the old machines 只是修飾語，動詞用單數 has。have、are、were 都是複數動詞。

stem: Not only the posters but also the website ____ been updated with the new camp schedule.
explain_zh: not only A but also B 的動詞與最靠近的主詞 the website 一致，單數用 has。其餘三個都是複數動詞。

stem: Either my parents or my older brother ____ going to pick me up after the competition.
explain_zh: either A or B 的動詞與較靠近的主詞 my older brother 一致，用單數 is。are、were、have 都是複數形式。

stem: The latest news about the typhoon warnings ____ spreading very quickly on social media.
explain_zh: news 字尾雖有 s，卻是不可數名詞，動詞用單數 is；中間的 about the typhoon warnings 只是修飾語。其餘三個都是複數動詞。

stem: Mathematics and chemistry ____ my two favourite subjects, though both take hours of practice.
explain_zh: 兩個學科用 and 連接，主詞變成複數，動詞用 are。單一學科名稱才視為單數，這裡是兩科並列。

stem: Everyone in the two graduating classes ____ to bring a reusable bottle to the camp.
explain_zh: everyone 是單數不定代名詞，動詞用 needs。need 是複數形，are needing 不符合狀態動詞用法，have need 不是正確的動詞形式。

stem: Three quarters of the electricity in this building ____ from the solar panels on the roof.
explain_zh: 分數或百分比的動詞要看 of 後面的名詞，electricity 是不可數，所以用單數 comes。若後面是複數名詞才用 come。

stem: The biology teacher, together with her students, ____ planting young trees along the fence.
explain_zh: together with 引導的片語不影響主詞的單複數，主詞仍是 The biology teacher，動詞用 is。類似的還有 as well as、along with。

stem: We will start the experiment as soon as the teacher ____ the safety instructions.
explain_zh: as soon as 引導的時間副詞子句要用現在式代替未來式，所以用 finishes。will finish 犯了「時間副詞子句不用未來式」的錯，finished 和 is finishing 時態不合。

stem: By the time the ambulance finally arrived, the injured runner ____ consciousness again.
explain_zh: By the time＋過去式，主要子句要用過去完成式表示「更早發生」，所以是 had regained。has regained 與過去時間不合，其餘兩個沒有表達先後。

stem: She had already left for the airport when I finally ____ to return her notebook.
explain_zh: 兩件過去的事，先發生的用過去完成式 had left，後發生的用過去簡單式 called。兩句都用過去完成式就分不出先後，have called 與過去時間不合。

stem: If it ____ heavily tomorrow, the outdoor graduation ceremony will be moved to the gymnasium.
explain_zh: 條件副詞子句用現在式代替未來式，所以用 rains。will rain 違反這個規則，rained 是過去式，is raining 指現在正在下。

stem: I ____ English for nine years by the time I graduate from senior high school.
explain_zh: by the time＋現在式表示未來某時間點，主要子句要用未來完成式 will have studied 表示「到那時已持續」。will study 沒有完成的意思，其餘兩個時態不合。

stem: Hardly ____ the announcement when the whole class began cheering very loudly.
explain_zh: 否定副詞 Hardly 放句首時後面要倒裝，而且句型是 Hardly had＋主詞＋p.p....when＋過去式。we had heard 沒有倒裝，其餘兩個時態也不符合這個句型。

stem: No sooner had the concert started ____ the power in the whole hall suddenly went out.
explain_zh: No sooner...than... 是固定搭配，表示「一…就…」；Hardly／Scarcely 才搭配 when。then 是副詞，that 在這裡不能當連接詞。

stem: Until last year, our school ____ never held an online meeting for parents and teachers.
explain_zh: Until last year 是過去的時間點，表示「在那之前從未」要用過去完成式 had never held。has 和 have 都指現在完成，was 無法構成完成式。

stem: When I finally get home tonight, my younger sister ____ the whole series already.
explain_zh: 未來某時間點之前已完成的動作用未來完成式 will have watched。watches 是現在式，has watched 指到現在為止，had watched 指過去。

stem: It was the first time that he ____ in front of an audience of two hundred people.
explain_zh: It was the first time that... 後面固定用過去完成式 had spoken。若主要子句是 It is the first time 才用現在完成式。

stem: She has been volunteering at the animal shelter ever since she ____ senior high school.
explain_zh: since 引導的子句用過去簡單式表示起點，主要子句才用現在完成進行式。enters 是現在式，has entered 和 had entered 都不能當起點。

stem: We will not leave the classroom until the teacher ____ that everyone has handed in the form.
explain_zh: until 引導時間副詞子句，用現在式代替未來式，所以是 confirms。will confirm 違反規則，confirmed 是過去式，is confirming 語意不合。

stem: The film had already begun when we finally ____ our seats in the dark theatre.
explain_zh: 先發生的用過去完成式 had begun，後發生的用過去簡單式 found。兩個都用過去完成式就分不出先後，find 和 have found 時態也不合。

stem: By 2050, many scientists believe that global sea levels ____ by another twenty centimetres.
explain_zh: By＋未來年份表示「到那時為止已完成」，用未來完成式 will have risen。will rise 只是單純未來，rise 和 have risen 都不能表達未來完成。

stem: My grandmother told me that she ____ in that old wooden house for over fifty years.
explain_zh: 主要子句 told 是過去式，表示「在那之前已持續」要用過去完成式 had lived。has lived 與過去的轉述不合，lives 和 lived 都無法表達更早的持續。

stem: The angry coach made every player ____ five extra laps after that disappointing match.
explain_zh: 使役動詞 make 在主動語態中接原形動詞，所以是 make somebody run。to run、running、ran 都不符合 make 的句型；只有變成被動時才用 be made to V。

stem: My parents will not let me ____ out on weekday evenings during the exam week.
explain_zh: 使役動詞 let 後面固定接原形動詞，所以是 let me go。to go、going、gone 都不能接在 let 之後。

stem: I had my old laptop ____ at the small repair shop near the train station yesterday.
explain_zh: have＋事物＋p.p. 表示「請別人把某物…」，筆電是被修的，所以用 fixed。fix 和 to fix 會變成筆電自己去修，fixing 表示正在進行的主動動作。

stem: We finally got the school ____ recycling bins in every corridor this semester.
explain_zh: get somebody to V 表示「說服某人做某事」，後面接不定詞。install 原形只能用在 make／have 之後，其餘兩個形式也不符合 get 的句型。

stem: She had her younger brother ____ the poster on the classroom wall before lunch.
explain_zh: have＋人＋原形動詞，表示「請某人做某事」，所以用 put。to put 是 get 的句型，putting 和 puts 都不能接在 have＋人之後。

stem: The loud construction noise outside made it impossible ____ on the reading passage.
explain_zh: make it＋形容詞＋to V 是常見句型，it 是虛受詞，真正的受詞是不定詞片語。原形、動名詞、過去分詞在這個句型中都不能使用。

stem: Our English teacher had us ____ our essays aloud to a partner before handing them in.
explain_zh: have＋人＋原形動詞表示「要某人做某事」，所以用 read。to read 是 get 的用法，reading 和 reads 都不符合這個句型。

stem: I need to get my eyes ____ before I order a new pair of glasses online.
explain_zh: get＋事物＋p.p. 表示「讓某物被…」，眼睛是被檢查的，所以用 checked。check 和 to check 會變成眼睛去檢查別人，checking 表主動進行。

stem: Nothing his friends said could make him ____ his mind about the debate competition.
explain_zh: 使役動詞 make 主動時接原形，所以是 make him change his mind。to change、changing、changed 都不能接在 make＋受詞之後。

stem: This new study app helps students ____ their limited study time much more efficiently.
explain_zh: help 後面可以接原形動詞或不定詞，所以用 manage。managing 和 managed 都不符合 help 的句型，to be managed 是被動，語意也不通。

stem: Let me ____ you a hand with those heavy boxes of donated books and clothes.
explain_zh: let 是使役動詞，後面一定接原形動詞，所以是 let me give。to give、giving、given 都不能接在 let 之後。

stem: She got all her classmates ____ the online questionnaire during yesterday's lunch break.
explain_zh: get＋人＋to V 表示「讓某人去做某事」，所以用 to complete。complete 原形是 make／have 的用法，其餘兩個形式也不符合 get 的句型。
